description: This file defines a PHP class SageMakerMetricsClient that extends AwsClient, used as a client to interact with the Amazon SageMaker Metrics Service. It includes method annotations for batch operations related to metrics.

classes.name: SageMakerMetricsClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon SageMaker Metrics Service, providing methods for batch retrieving and putting metrics.

methods.name: batchGetMetrics
methods.description: Method to synchronously retrieve metrics in batch from SageMaker.

methods.name: batchGetMetricsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of batchGetMetrics for non-blocking metric retrieval.

methods.name: batchPutMetrics
methods.description: Method to synchronously send metrics in batch to SageMaker.

methods.name: batchPutMetricsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of batchPutMetrics for non-blocking metric submission.
